crm_notes: Mid-market product company building a guided onboarding copilot embedded inside their web app. Evaluating Redwood Hosted API first for speed of integration, with a runway to Dedicated for predictable throughput. Primary asks: streaming with low perceived latency (p95 perceived <300ms), robust tool-calling (trigger product actions, db lookups), and token cost caps per user/flow to control monthly spend. POC scope: integrate streaming responses + simple tool calling (open ticket, fetch user profile), run synthetic scenario of 200 concurrent sessions to observe latency and token usage. SE ran live demo showing streaming and function invocation; product team liked handling of partial responses. Security/compliance: SOC2 required, SSO/SAML, audit logs and KMS for keys; EU data residency for some enterprise customers — currently okay with regional routing but will ask about Private for strict residency.
requirements_summary: Workload: chat/agent focused on guided flows. Latency: p95 streaming perceived <300ms; tail latency concerns. Throughput: ~150-300 concurrent active sessions during peak onboarding launches. Cost sensitivity: strict token caps per-user and per-flow; need predictability for forecasted ARR. Model preferences: open Llama-family style models acceptable; prefer variants with tool-calling support. Routing: want fallback to cheaper model when capacity constrained. Observability: per-route token/latency breakdowns and tracing hooks.
poC_notes: POC running on Hosted API. Metrics to collect: p50/p95 streaming latency, tokens per session, cost per 1k sessions. Success criteria: <300ms perceived p95 for streaming in-app, token usage within capped budget, successful tool-calls with <500ms end-to-end. If successful, move to Dedicated for predictable capacity and SLA.
quotes: We need the copilot to feel instantaneous — users drop off if responses lag.
Token spend is the biggest unknown; want hard caps per user and automatic throttling.
recent_feedback: Liked streaming demo; concerned about variance in tail latency during synthetic load. Asked for a detailed runbook for how Dedicated isolates noisy neighbors and for pricing scenarios at 250k monthly active onboardings.
sales_playbook_stage_notes: PLG-to-sales motion: heavy self-serve integration into dev environment, then SE-led POC. Upsell path to Dedicated tied to latency guarantees and committed ARR.
